s.en: can assign starting DND abilities.\n\nAt the top of the "Adventurer" tab, assign the six abilities with 5e point buy: base values 8-15,

s.zh: 点（9～13 每点 1，14、15 每点 2），种族和背景加值另算。已经按技能预填了推荐分配，可以“全部 8”后重新分配。点“确认”后锁定；不确认也按当前分配生效。
s.en: points total (9-13 cost 1 each, 14 and 15 cost 2 each), race and background bonuses counted separately. A recommended assignment is already prefilled from skills; you can "all 8" and reassign. Click "confirm" to lock it; without confirming, the current assignment still takes effect.

s.zh: 13 岁以上的人有冒险者等级 1～20 和六项属性（力量、敏捷、体质、智力、感知、魅力）。击杀、守住袭击、完成任务、DND 事件里程碑给经验，日常工作也有少量；每 4 级一次属性提升。关闭后不再获得经验、属性没有效果、隐藏“冒险者”分页；已有的等级和属性保留。
s.en: Everyone over 13 has adventurer levels 1-20 and six abilities (Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma). Kills, defending against raids, completing quests and DND event milestones give XP, and daily work gives a little too; an ability score improvement every 4 levels. When off, no more XP is gained, abilities have no effect and the "Adventurer" tab is hidden; existing levels and abilities are kept.

s.zh: 每 50 点技能经验 = 1 × 倍率 冒险者经验；每天前 80 点全额，之后 ×0.5。0 = 关闭。
s.en: Every 50 skill XP = 1 × multiplier adventurer XP; the first 80 per day in full, after that ×0.5. 0 = off.

s.zh: 1.71.0：建筑“探索公告板”（杂项）每天贴出 6 份分等阶的委托：守卫家园、远征讨伐（怪物巢穴）、清剿据点。等阶青铜 / 白银 / 黄金 / 秘银 / 传说，需要殖民地最高冒险者等级 1 / 5 / 9 / 13 / 17；完成给银币和物品报酬，接取人得到“任务点数 × 0.5”的冒险者经验。关闭后不再刷新委托，已接的委托照常进行。
s.en: 1.71.0: the building "exploration notice board" (Misc) posts 6 tiered jobs each day: defend the home, expedition (monster lairs), clear strongholds. Tiers bronze / silver / gold / mithral / legendary need a top colony adventurer level of 1 / 5 / 9 / 13 / 17; completion gives silver and item rewards, and the takers gain "quest points × 0.5" adventurer XP. When off, no new jobs refresh; accepted ones continue as usual.

s.zh: %（六维的数值效果、技能学习速度、部位生命成长；0% 等于只看等级）
s.en: % (numeric effects of the six abilities, skill learning speed, part health growth; 0% means level only)

s.zh: 调每 1 点属性调整值（每 +2 属性）带来多少效果。100% 是原来的数值，越低属性差距越小，0% 等于属性没有数值效果。\n\n线性效果按比例缩放：近战伤害 / 移速 / 心灵敏感度每点
s.en: Sets how much effect each ability modifier point (each +2 ability) gives. 100% is the original value; lower makes ability gaps smaller, and 0% means abilities have no numeric effect.\n\nLinear effects scale proportionally: melee damage / move speed / psychic sensitivity per point

和上面的“属性效果强度”相乘；不改属性数值、上限、专长门槛和豁免。野兽的野性等级不受影响。

每个种族有擅长和笨拙的属性：擅长的六维属性线性效果（近战伤害、心灵敏感度、部位生命、职业强度等）整个 ×1.5（传奇种族 ×1.75，和天赋特性相乘；效果低于 ×1 时不乘），负重、采矿等其他效果的倍率 ×1.5；笨拙的每点正调整值 ×0.5（负调整值不乘）；擅长的传奇属性每点 ×1.5（传奇种族 ×1.75），人类所有传奇属性 ×1.1。只改效果，不改属性数值、上限和专长门槛。在“冒险者”分页每项后面标“擅长 / 笨拙”。\n关闭后所有种族 ×1（天赋特性照常）。
s.en: Each race has strong and weak abilities: a strong ability's whole linear effect (melee damage, psychic sensitivity, part health, class power, etc.) ×1.5 (legendary races ×1.75, multiplying with talent traits; not applied when the effect is below ×1), and the multiplier of other effects like carrying capacity and mining ×1.5; each positive modifier point of a weak ability ×0.5 (negative modifiers aren't multiplied); each point of a strong legend attribute ×1.5 (legendary races ×1.75), and all legend attributes of humans ×1.1. Only changes effects, not ability values, caps or feat requirements. Each entry on the "Adventurer" tab is marked "strong / weak".\nWhen off, all races are ×1 (talent traits as usual).

s.zh: 手动分配初始属性（购点制）
开启后新的殖民者（开局、加入、招募）的六维由玩家在“冒险者”分页按 5e 购点制分配：基础值 8～15，9～13 每点 1、14 / 15 每点 2，种族和背景加值另算。预填按技能推荐的标准数组（15/14/13/12/10/8 = 27 点），确认后锁定。每人只有一次。关闭后直接用推荐分配。1.76.0 之前生成的小人没有这一项。
s.en: When on, the six abilities of new colonists (starting, joining, recruited) are assigned by the player on the "Adventurer" tab with 5e point buy: base values 8-15, 9-13 cost 1 each, 14 / 15 cost 2 each, race and background bonuses counted separately. Prefilled with the standard array recommended from skills (15/14/13/12/10/8 = 27 points), locked after confirming. Once per person only. When off, the recommended assignment is used directly. Pawns generated before 1.76.0 don't have this.

s.zh: 开启后殖民者升到 4、8、12、16 级时自动属性提升：职业主属性优先（装了 VPE 且有 DND 职业），否则加在最高的一项。关闭时在“冒险者”分页或升级信件里手动加点。敌人和访客永远自动。
s.en: When on, colonists automatically improve abilities on reaching levels 4, 8, 12 and 16: the class's main ability first (with VPE installed and a DND class), otherwise the highest one. When off, assign points manually on the "Adventurer" tab or in the level-up letter. Enemies and visitors are always automatic.

s.zh: 检测到 Isekai RPG Leveling 时默认开启：冒险者等级、经验、加点照常，但六维属性的数值效果关闭（交给 Isekai 自己的属性，避免叠加）。关掉这一项可以让两套属性同时生效。没有 Isekai 时这一项不起作用。
s.en: On by default when Isekai RPG Leveling is detected: adventurer levels, XP and ability points work as usual, but the numeric effects of the six abilities are off (left to Isekai's own stats, to avoid stacking). Turn this off to let both stat systems apply at once. Without Isekai this does nothing.

s.zh: 袭击和 DND 事件的人形敌人按袭击点数拿冒险者等级：每人分到的点数 ÷ 45 + 1 级，±2 浮动；领队 +3，精英兵种 +2～+5；剧情首领 12～18 级。等级越高的敌人每人占的点数越多（每级 +3%），所以人数变少。访客、商队 1～3 级。\n开不开 Isekai 共存模式都用这一个开关（1.63.0 起不再分两份）。
s.en: Humanlike enemies in raids and DND events get adventurer levels from raid points: each person's share of points ÷ 45 + 1 level, ±2 variation; leaders +3, elite pawn kinds +2 to +5; story bosses level 12-18. Higher-level enemies take more points each (+3% per level), so there are fewer of them. Visitors and caravans level 1-3.\nThis one switch is used with or without Isekai coexistence mode (no longer split in two since 1.63.0).

s.zh: 敌人等级上限：殖民地最高等级 +
s.en: Enemy level cap: colony's highest level +

s.zh: 开启时袭击敌人的冒险者等级不超过殖民地最高冒险者等级 + N（剧情首领不受限）。防止开局碰到高等级敌人。
s.en: When on, raiding enemies' adventurer levels don't exceed the colony's highest adventurer level + N (story bosses aren't limited). Prevents meeting high-level enemies early on.

s.zh: 攻击者每比目标低 1 级，近战和远程命中率 ×(1 − 2%)，最多 −50%（低 10 级 ×0.8，低 25 级以上 ×0.5）。等级按冒险者等级（含传奇等级 21～40），动物按野性等级；机械体、炮塔、传奇怪物没有等级，不参与。
s.en: For each level the attacker is below the target, melee and ranged hit chance ×(1 − 2%), up to −50% (10 levels lower ×0.8, 25 or more lower ×0.5). Levels are adventurer levels (including legend levels 21-40); animals use wild levels; mechanoids, turrets and legendary monsters have no level and don't participate.

s.zh: 伤口和缺失部位的疼痛 ÷ 部位生命倍率：部位生命 ×2 的人受同样的伤只有一半疼痛，因此更晚因疼痛倒地。冒险者按等级、体质、传奇血量等的部位生命倍率，动物按野性等级；传奇怪物不变。关闭后疼痛照原版，只按伤口大小算。
s.en: Pain from wounds and missing parts ÷ part health multiplier: someone with ×2 part health feels only half the pain from the same injury, so they go down from pain later. Adventurers use their part health multiplier from level, Constitution, legend health etc.; animals use wild levels; legendary monsters unchanged. When off, pain is vanilla, based only on wound size.

s.zh: 总生命随部位生命缩放
s.en: Total health scales with part health

s.zh: 原版的致死伤害阈值（全身伤口合计 150 × 体型生命倍率就死）、健康百分比和失血速度都不看部位生命倍率，部位血再厚也会先死于“伤势过重”或失血。开启时：致死阈值 × 部位生命倍率，伤口扣的健康% 和总失血速度 ÷ 部位生命倍率。冒险者按等级、体质、传奇血量等的部位生命倍率，动物按野性等级；传奇怪物不变。关闭后照原版。
s.en: Vanilla's lethal damage threshold (death at total wounds of 150 × body size health multiplier), health percentage and bleeding rate ignore the part health multiplier, so however thick part health is, they still die first of "overwhelming injuries" or blood loss. When on: lethal threshold × part health multiplier, health % lost to wounds and total bleed rate ÷ part health multiplier. Adventurers use their part health multiplier from level, Constitution, legend health etc.; animals use wild levels; legendary monsters unchanged. When off, vanilla.
